# BBJake

> BBJake (Jacob Coburn) is a Visalia, California live streamer, YouTuber and event host, known as the 559's #1 content creator. He is CEO of BeenBlessed, a self-owned Christian clothing brand.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.bbjake.com/): live stream, latest videos, merch, partnerships and links
- [About BBJake](https://www.bbjake.com/about): who he is, events, collaborations, community work and how to partner
- [Media Kit](https://www.bbjake.com/media-kit): audience numbers, past events, collaborations and ways to partner
- [Press](https://www.bbjake.com/press): news coverage and media requests
- [Community](https://www.bbjake.com/community): giveback events and the BeenBlessed nonprofit goal

## Contact
- Brand partnerships and business: info@bbjake.com

## Facts (as of November 2026)
- Also known as: Jacob Coburn, BB Jake, bbjakee
- Based in: Visalia, California (Tulare County, the 559)
- CEO of BeenBlessed, a self-owned Christian clothing brand
- Instagram @bbjake: 50.8K followers. TikTok @bbjakelive: 21.3K followers, 3.1M likes. Twitch bbjakee: 4.8K followers. YouTube @bbjakee: 1.1K subscribers
- Events: BeenBlessed boxing events (the second one drew 350+ people), 559 Song Wars, a water balloon fight at Mill Creek Park (10,000+ balloons), BeenBlessed BBQ (200+ people fed, free haircuts), a 1v1 tournament, a BeenBlessed pop-up and car meet
- Took a homeless man named Popeye on a 48-hour trip to LA (YouTube, Oct 2026)
- Gave $1,000 to strangers with No Guard for the #BeenBlessedChallenge (No Guard YouTube, Nov 2026)
- Collaborations: Adin Ross, Richard Torrez Jr., Deen The Great, Yvng Ecko, Adrien Broner, DaBoii, Neon, Corona, AyhTee. Featured on SportsCenter's Instagram
